description: This file implements the IMemory interface and related classes for Android's binder IPC mechanism, including heap management, memory mapping, and binder death handling.

classes.name: HeapCache
classes.description: Manages cached IMemoryHeap objects and handles binder death notifications.

classes.name: BpMemoryHeap
classes.description: Binder proxy for IMemoryHeap, provides access to heap properties and manages memory mapping.

classes.name: BpMemory
classes.description: Binder proxy for IMemory, provides access to memory and its properties.

classes.name: BnMemory
classes.description: Binder stub implementation for IMemory, handles incoming IPC transactions.

classes.name: BnMemoryHeap
classes.description: Binder stub implementation for IMemoryHeap, handles incoming IPC transactions.

methods.name: fastPointer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the memory at a given offset within the binder's memory heap.

methods.name: unsecurePointer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the memory, unprotected, within the heap.

methods.name: pointer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the memory, same as unsecurePointer.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the memory block.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Returns the offset within the heap where the memory starts.

methods.name: getMemory
methods.description: Retrieves the memory heap and its offset and size.

methods.name: assertReallyMapped
methods.description: Performs remote call to map the heap if not already mapped.

methods.name: getBase
methods.description: Returns the base address of the heap.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the heap.

methods.name: getFlags
methods.description: Returns the flags associated with the heap.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset within the heap.
